## Sabotage

Revolutions start small: a burned supply ship, a freed prisoner, a garrison that never reports back.

Defeat twenty-five Marines.

## Free the Slaves

Fisher Tiger freed thousands from Mariejois and never once asked who they were.

Free three slaves. Celestial Dragons travel with them when they visit an island.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Sabotage](f_revolutionaries.md#q-6ec258158a5f7076)

**Tasks**

- Reach 3 freed slaves

**Rewards**

## Officer

Officers run whole networks of spies and fighters. Koala taught Fish-Man Karate to half of them.

Reach the rank of Officer, defeat five Marine captains and belong to a crew. Crews are open to every faction.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Free the Slaves](f_revolutionaries.md#q-550061b80925572c)

**Tasks**

- Rank: Officer
- Belong to a crew (/crew create &lt;name&gt;, or accept an invite)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +8,500, Loyalty +2
